originalIntent: Turn the live 3D Funnel Environment into a procedural Funnel Foundry. Sebastian must be able to reshape the funnel ecosystem itself with sliders and symmetry controls, duplicate whole arms across X/Y/Z or radial symmetry, instantiate reusable high-level funnel systems from a library, create new structure templates, see projected storage/complexity before committing, and press one explicit Reassemble control that deterministically rebuilds the whole graph. It must be phone-first and usable as a full-screen home-screen web app. The editor should support iterative architecture experiments without letting visualization silently mutate the production Funnel kernel. Funnel questions may be delegated to parallel Sebastian solver workers. Each worker receives the same open-ended question explicitly framed as a question from Sebastian and independently proposes a solution. Their agreement is intentionally used to manufacture decision confidence; they do not pretend their proposed solution was previously stated by Sebastian.
page0Obligations: Controls change the topology/geometry of the Funnel ecosystem, not merely camera appearance.
Whole funnel arms and packaged systems can be duplicated.
Symmetry/cloning works across multiple spatial axes in the 3D environment.
One explicit Reassemble action applies the draft architecture.
High-level funnel systems are reusable library assets with predefined internal order.
A template mechanism can define new reusable structures without hand-wiring every internal stage.
Build-time resource estimates include projected storage based on architecture size and expected usage.
Resource pressure is advisory (green/yellow/red), not an arbitrary blocker.
The experience is phone-first and supports standalone/full-screen home-screen use.
Architectures can be serialized so experiments can be saved, compared, exported, and reloaded.
The visual editor does not silently rewrite the sealed production Funnel law; promotion remains an explicit later act.
Multiple proxies citing the same underlying Sebastian statement improve retrieval confidence but do not multiply the evidence weight.
Corrections and newer explicit statements can supersede older statements without deleting historical evidence.
Sebastian-1 through Sebastian-N are independent solution workers, not owner-evidence impersonators.
Each worker receives an open-ended Funnel question framed as being asked by Sebastian; the question must not imply a preferred solution.
Independent agreeing solution ballots are allowed to increase convergence confidence on purpose.
Worker consensus is labeled synthetic/solution confidence and must not be mislabeled as evidence that Sebastian previously chose that answer.
Literal Sebastian evidence remains a separate channel and is never multiplied merely because several workers retrieved the same source.
Material disagreement between solver workers creates alternatives or a follow-up question instead of being silently averaged away.

decisions.engine: One deterministic graph generator + reusable system-package definitions; do not fork five separate codebases.
decisions.editing: Draft configuration is separate from assembled graph. Sliders edit draft; Reassemble atomically regenerates geometry.
decisions.symmetry: Treat spatial duplication as transforms over logical package instances, not duplicated hard-coded source.
decisions.packages: Each library package owns ordered internal stages and declared input/output role.
decisions.templates: Custom templates use the same package contract as built-ins.
decisions.storage: Estimate serialized design bytes plus projected run-history bytes from runs/day, retention, and a configurable storage budget.
decisions.safety: Red/yellow cost states warn but do not veto Reassemble.
decisions.privacy: Design state stays device-local by default; export is explicit.
decisions.productionBoundary: Foundry edits experiments. Applying an experimental architecture to Funnel law is a separate promotion step.
decisions.sebastianProxies: Replaced by Sebastian solver workers: independent workers receive open-ended Funnel questions as if Sebastian is directly asking them for a solution.
decisions.proxyAuthority: Solver workers may propose solutions and vote. They may not claim Sebastian previously said their proposal unless a separate literal owner-evidence record supports it.
decisions.proxyReconciliation: Multiple independent agreeing solver ballots intentionally increase synthetic decision confidence. Literal owner evidence is deduplicated separately.
decisions.confidenceChannels: Keep owner-evidence confidence and solver-consensus confidence separate. The first describes what Sebastian has actually established; the second describes how strongly independent solution attempts converge.

pipeline: Extract structural controls and non-negotiable interactions
Define resource estimator and stress checks

systems.title: Draft Architecture Config
systems.overview: Editable parameters for geometry, system counts, symmetry, redundancy, usage forecast and custom packages.
acceptance: Slider changes do not mutate the assembled graph until Reassemble.
Config can serialize and restore.

systems.title: System Package Library
systems.overview: Reusable ordered funnel subsystems with predefined internal stages and external ports.
acceptance: Built-ins can be added/removed or copied without manually recreating internal order.
Custom templates use the same package contract.

systems.title: Procedural Topology Generator
systems.overview: Converts package instances and architecture parameters into nodes and edges.
acceptance: Same config produces the same logical graph.
No generated edge points to a missing node.

systems.title: 3D Symmetry & Clone Engine
systems.overview: Applies radial and X/Y/Z mirror transforms to package geometry while preserving logical relationships.
acceptance: Clone X/Y/Z visibly duplicates selected architecture branches.
Clones remain connected to the correct intake/convergence paths.

systems.title: Atomic Reassembler
systems.overview: Regenerates the complete graph from the current draft in one explicit action.
acceptance: Reassemble replaces the prior experimental graph atomically.
Failed validation leaves the previous assembled graph intact.

systems.title: Resource Forecast
systems.overview: Predicts serialized design and retained run-history storage before build.
acceptance: Shows projected bytes/MB and green/yellow/red budget state.
Runs/day, retention and budget alter the estimate immediately.

systems.title: Architecture Stress Check
systems.overview: Checks reachability, dangling edges, convergence and redundancy metrics.
acceptance: Reports broken paths before promotion.
Does not claim semantic correctness from graph validity alone.

systems.title: Phone-first Full-screen Shell
systems.overview: Compact controls, safe-area handling, installable/standalone meta and touch-friendly 3D navigation.
acceptance: Primary Foundry workflow works by touch.
Page can be saved to the phone home screen and used in standalone display mode where the browser supports it.

systems.title: Sebastian Solver Workers
systems.overview: Parallel isolated workers answer open-ended Funnel questions framed as direct questions from Sebastian. They propose solutions rather than impersonating Sebastian's prior beliefs.
acceptance: Every worker receives materially the same non-leading question.
Worker outputs are isolated until ballot collection.
Agreement can raise synthetic solution confidence.
Disagreement remains visible and can branch the Funnel.
No worker proposal is relabeled as an owner statement.

systems.title: Dual Confidence Channels
systems.overview: Track literal owner-evidence confidence separately from synthetic solver-consensus confidence.
acceptance: Repeated retrieval of one owner statement does not multiply owner evidence.
Independent agreeing solution ballots can legitimately add solver votes.
The Funnel never confuses solver consensus with an explicit Sebastian decision.

failureModes: Duplicating identical logic can duplicate identical mistakes; redundancy metrics must not be labeled truth.
Too many visible nodes can make the map unreadable; detail toggles and tracing remain necessary.
A storage forecast is an estimate, not a promise about browser/device quotas.
Geometry transforms must never change logical edge direction.
Experimental configs must not automatically overwrite production Funnel law.
doneCriteria: A phone user can alter arm counts/redundancy/symmetry/resource assumptions without editing code.
Clone-X, Clone-Y and Clone-Z operations materially change the assembled 3D topology.
Built-in system packages can be added in multiple copies.
A custom system template can be created and instantiated.
Reassemble regenerates nodes/edges and redraws the environment.
The UI displays storage forecast and budget state before reassembly.
Automated tests cover deterministic build, no dangling edges, package cloning, symmetry, storage estimator and legacy Funnel path preservation.
